cards.back:
To copy a file from the internet to your own device.
Bahasa Indonesia: mengunduh
Example: I will download the new game to my tablet tonight.
cards.say: download. To copy a file from the internet to your own device. I will download the new game to my tablet tonight.

cards.back:
To send a file from your device to the internet.
Bahasa Indonesia: mengunggah
Example: She will upload her drawing to the school website today.
cards.say: upload. To send a file from your device to the internet. She will upload her drawing to the school website today.

cards.back:
A secret word that lets you into an account.
Bahasa Indonesia: kata sandi
Example: Never tell your password to anyone except your parents.
cards.say: password. A secret word that lets you into an account. Never tell your password to anyone except your parents.

cards.back:
A group of pages on the internet about one subject.
Bahasa Indonesia: situs web
Example: Our school has a website with news and photos.
cards.say: website. A group of pages on the internet about one subject. Our school has a website with news and photos.

cards.back:
A tool that you use to look at pages on the internet.
Bahasa Indonesia: peramban
Example: Open the browser and type the address in the top bar.
cards.say: browser. A tool that you use to look at pages on the internet. Open the browser and type the address in the top bar.

cards.back:
The flat part of a device where pictures and words appear.
Bahasa Indonesia: layar
Example: Too much time looking at a screen can make your eyes tired.
cards.say: screen. The flat part of a device where pictures and words appear. Too much time looking at a screen can make your eyes tired.

cards.back:
A small container that stores electrical energy for a device.
Bahasa Indonesia: baterai
Example: The battery on my phone is almost empty.
cards.say: battery. A small container that stores electrical energy for a device. The battery on my phone is almost empty.

cards.back:
Working without wires.
Bahasa Indonesia: nirkabel
Example: A wireless speaker played music across the garden.
cards.say: wireless. Working without wires. A wireless speaker played music across the garden.

cards.back:
The instructions that tell a computer what to do.
Bahasa Indonesia: perangkat lunak
Example: The teacher installed new software to help us practise spelling.
cards.say: software. The instructions that tell a computer what to do. The teacher installed new software to help us practise spelling.

cards.back:
A group of computers or devices joined together.
Bahasa Indonesia: jaringan
Example: The library computers are connected to one network.
cards.say: network. A group of computers or devices joined together. The library computers are connected to one network.

cards.back:
A harmful piece of code that can damage a computer.
Bahasa Indonesia: virus komputer
Example: An old file carried a virus and slowed the laptop down.
cards.say: virus. A harmful piece of code that can damage a computer. An old file carried a virus and slowed the laptop down.

cards.back:
The title at the top of a news story.
Bahasa Indonesia: judul berita
Example: The headline said that the school had won the quiz.
cards.say: headline. The title at the top of a news story. The headline said that the school had won the quiz.

cards.back:
To send out a programme on radio or television.
Bahasa Indonesia: menyiarkan
Example: The channel will broadcast the football final live tonight.
cards.say: broadcast. To send out a programme on radio or television. The channel will broadcast the football final live tonight.

cards.back:
A message that tries to make people buy something.
Bahasa Indonesia: iklan
Example: The advertisement for the new trainers appeared between the cartoons.
cards.say: advertisement. A message that tries to make people buy something. The advertisement for the new trainers appeared between the cartoons.

cards.back:
A series of audio shows that you can listen to on a device.
Bahasa Indonesia: siniar, podcast
Example: We listen to a funny podcast about animals on the way to school.
cards.say: podcast. A series of audio shows that you can listen to on a device. We listen to a funny podcast about animals on the way to school.

cards.back:
A film made from a series of moving drawings.
Bahasa Indonesia: animasi
Example: The animation about a brave turtle took a year to make.
cards.say: animation. A film made from a series of moving drawings. The animation about a brave turtle took a year to make.

cards.back:
A website where a person writes regularly about a topic.
Bahasa Indonesia: blog
Example: My aunt writes a blog about the food she cooks.
cards.say: blog. A website where a person writes regularly about a topic. My aunt writes a blog about the food she cooks.

cards.back:
A device used to take photographs or videos.
Bahasa Indonesia: kamera
Example: He pointed the camera at the sunrise and pressed the button.
cards.say: camera. A device used to take photographs or videos. He pointed the camera at the sunrise and pressed the button.

cards.back:
The set of keys you press to type on a computer.
Bahasa Indonesia: papan ketik
Example: She tapped quickly on the keyboard to finish her story.
cards.say: keyboard. The set of keys you press to type on a computer. She tapped quickly on the keyboard to finish her story.

cards.back:
Words sent from one person to another.
Bahasa Indonesia: pesan
Example: I sent a message to my cousin to wish her luck.
cards.say: message. Words sent from one person to another. I sent a message to my cousin to wish her luck.

cards.back:
Connected to the internet.
Bahasa Indonesia: daring
Example: Our teacher posts the homework online every Friday.
cards.say: online. Connected to the internet. Our teacher posts the homework online every Friday.

cards.back:
The right to keep your own information secret.
Bahasa Indonesia: privasi
Example: Keep your privacy safe by not sharing your address on the internet.
cards.say: privacy. The right to keep your own information secret. Keep your privacy safe by not sharing your address on the internet.

cards.back:
A small machine made for a particular job.
Bahasa Indonesia: perangkat
Example: The tablet is a useful device for reading and drawing.
cards.say: device. A small machine made for a particular job. The tablet is a useful device for reading and drawing.

cards.back:
A machine that can do tasks by itself.
Bahasa Indonesia: robot
Example: The robot arm lifted the boxes and placed them on the shelf.
cards.say: robot. A machine that can do tasks by itself. The robot arm lifted the boxes and placed them on the shelf.
